description: Add a plain-text comment to a Jira issue. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the comment being posted; the new comment id is delivered when the job completes. Write action.
embedding_description: Post a plain-text comment onto an existing Jira issue's comment thread - a status note, a question, a hand-off message - by giving the issue key and the comment body. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id immediately; the new comment's id arrives via job completion. The write side of a ticket's discussion thread.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the comment id -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the comment was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the comment posted. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the comment id lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm the comment was posted to the named issue and give the comment id. This adds visible content to a real ticket.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Add a comment to a Jira issue.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.not_found: the issue key does not exist. jira.permission_denied: the account cannot comment on this issue. jira.invalid_params: key or body was missing or empty.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.not_found: verify the issue key. jira.permission_denied: grant the service account comment permission on the project. jira.invalid_params: supply both key and a non-empty body.
